summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin bundle that configures a curated set of UI and workflow enhancements in one setup, including navigation panels, dashboard-style tools, snapshots, and conversation handoff features.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily an automation-oriented DSH Web bundle that packages and injects curated plugins to enhance the user interface and workflow (sidebars, status panels, task board, checkpoints, and handoff/snapshot capabilities). Evidence from the manifest and README shows it is intended for end-user productivity and UI workflow setup rather than core model coding, data transformation, or security tooling, with some moderate-risk operations involving file/sandbox state and external API access.
